post.summary: Receive authenticated brevo transactional email events

requestBody.description: At most 1 MiB of original JSON; authenticate before interpreting event data.

204.description: Events committed, deduplicated or intentionally ignored; no body.

401.description: Unknown connection, missing or invalid authentication, or signed timestamp outside policy.

413.description: Original payload or event batch exceeds the limit.

422.description: Authenticated JSON has an invalid shape.

503.description: Storage temporarily unavailable; receipt not acknowledged.

post.summary: Receive authenticated sendgrid transactional email events

parameters.name: X-Twilio-Email-Event-Webhook-Timestamp
parameters.description: Signed Unix seconds; at most 24 hours old or five minutes in the future.

requestBody.description: At most 1 MiB of original JSON; authenticate before interpreting event data.

204.description: Events committed, deduplicated or intentionally ignored; no body.

401.description: Unknown connection, missing or invalid authentication, or signed timestamp outside policy.

413.description: Original payload or event batch exceeds the limit.

422.description: Authenticated JSON has an invalid shape.

503.description: Storage temporarily unavailable; receipt not acknowledged.

brevoBearer.description: Private per-account webhook token configured in Brevo; HTTPS is required.

sendgridSignature.name: X-Twilio-Email-Event-Webhook-Signature
sendgridSignature.description: ECDSA P-256 SHA256 of timestamp plus original request bytes; verifies against the connection public key.
